purpose: Prepare an independently versioned Cloudflare Container transport preflight for Binance USD-M public exchangeInfo without modifying V0.1 or the active V0.2 Self-Hosted Mac authority.
pass_rule: PASS only if a real Cloudflare Container execution reaches the unchanged official Binance USD-M exchangeInfo endpoint with HTTP 200, parses a JSON object containing a non-empty symbols[] array, emits only the sanitized diagnostic fields, and performs zero R2 writes, zero holdout access, zero source switching, and zero trading.
fail_rule: Any non-200 provider response, invalid JSON, missing/empty symbols[] array, deployment failure, or evidence-boundary violation is FAIL/BLOCKED. Do not substitute a proxy, alternate provider, alternate endpoint, API-key workaround, or manually fabricated evidence.
post_pass_rule: A transport PASS alone does not authorize metadata capture migration. A separate versioned authority transition must explicitly supersede the V0.2 Self-Hosted Mac transport before any scheduled capture transport changes.
